ownership.application: Shared Dart account, subscription, localization and payment services
ownership.nativeView: Presentation and user intents only; never infer connection success from a command acknowledgement

snapshot.revision: nonnegative integer; strictly increases for each published snapshot
snapshot.accountGeneration: nonnegative integer; changes on sign-in, sign-out or account replacement

usage.usedBytes: nonnegative integer or null; null means unknown

traffic.uploadBps: nonnegative integer or null; null means no measurement
traffic.downloadBps: nonnegative integer or null; null means no measurement

snapshot.labels: map containing every requiredLabels key, resolved from the same ARB catalog as Flutter

command.id: nonempty string up to 128 characters; generated per user action
command.accountGeneration: snapshot generation associated with the action

selectServer.serverId: id from the current snapshot servers

receipt.accepted: boolean; does not mean the VPN transition completed

invariants: Snapshots never contain authorization tokens, passwords, subscription URLs or proxy credentials.
Native code must reject unsupported schema versions and ignore snapshots older than the last accepted revision.
Account generation changes replace all account-dependent presentation state before accepting further user commands.
Dart rejects commands for a stale account generation or a server id absent from the current managed subscription.
All customer text comes from labels or current customer data; no platform maintains a parallel translation table.
Traffic updates may be throttled, but authoritative connection/account transitions must be published immediately.
Safe mode never changes the host network or enables autostart entries.
Persisted authorization is owned by the shared session service and platform secure storage; native views do not retain it.
